paragraphs: Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development (NFED) is an autonomous, sector-agnostic startup incubator and premium co-working ecosystem registered under the societies registration framework to empower founders with early-stage velocity and institutional support.

NFED nurtures innovation-driven startups by providing seamless physical incubation infrastructure, high-fidelity mentoring channels, deep access to institutional and private seed funds, fabrication assets, and business matchmaking. Operated under the aegis of I.T.S. Engineering College, Greater Noida, NFED serves as the strategic regional node for transforming research and raw academic ideas into high-conversion, venture-backed startups.

faqs.question: What is Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development?
faqs.answer: Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development is a subsidiary of I.T.S. Engineering College that supports young entrepreneurs in commercializing their technologies and launching startups.

faqs.question: Who can benefit from the foundation?
faqs.answer: Students, faculty, and staff looking to develop their entrepreneurial skills, test startup ideas, and connect with investors can benefit from the foundation.

faqs.question: What resources does the foundation provide?
faqs.answer: The foundation offers mentorship, funding opportunities, networking support, and business development resources to help startups grow.

faqs.question: How does the foundation help bridge the gap between inventors and venture capitalists?
faqs.answer: It connects innovators with industry experts, investors, and mentors to transform ideas into viable businesses.

ourSpacesHeader.description: We provide dynamic workspaces, expert mentorship, networking opportunities, and business support services to help startups and entrepreneurs thrive.

ourSpaces.title: Acceleration Programs
ourSpaces.description: Access tailored incubation modules, prototype funding, venture mentorship, and investor matchmaking pipelines to scale your early-stage startup.

ourSpaces.title: Mentorship & Expert Guidance
ourSpaces.description: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with veteran entrepreneurs, technology experts, and IP advisors to accelerate product-market fit.

ourSpaces.title: Co-working Space & Infrastructure
ourSpaces.description: Scale in our premium co-working facility, featuring plug-and-play seating, smart meeting rooms, high-end compute systems, and prototyping labs.

ourSpaces.title: Fabrication & Tool Room
ourSpaces.description: Build deep prototypes using precision machinery, including CNC CO2 Laser Cutters, Plasma Cutters, and advanced manual prototyping tools.

ourSpaces.title: 3D Printing Facility
ourSpaces.description: Bring design concepts to life with professional FDM, SLA, and resin 3D printers, supporting over 40 types of specialized engineering filaments.

ourSpaces.title: AI & Simulations Grid
ourSpaces.description: Leverage state-of-the-art compute hardware on a flexible compute-rental basis for intensive AI model training and engineering simulations.

ourSpaces.title: Premium Meeting Rooms
ourSpaces.description: Host presentations, pitch panels, and board reviews in modern rooms featuring integrated AV gear, screen casting, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

schemesHeader.description: At Navrachna Foundation (NFED), we coordinate flagship incubation schemes that nurture entrepreneurs across every stage of their startup journey. These structured programs combine equity-free prototype grants, monthly fellowship stipends, intensive commercial scaling pipelines, and institutional resources to ensure early-stage ventures gain the right strategic assets to succeed.
